videos.prompt: Photorealistic, gentle cinematic shot. The woman stands in the sunny park garden and smiles warmly at the camera, a soft breeze moves the leaves and her hair slightly, she breathes calmly and gives a small loving nod. Slow gentle push-in, warm golden afternoon light. Her face, glasses and blue tropical-leaf dress stay exactly the same. Calm, peaceful, no sound effects needed.

Photorealistic heavenly scene. Seen from behind, the woman in the blue tropical-leaf dress walks slowly and steadily up the white marble staircase through soft glowing clouds toward Jesus, who waits at the top with open arms in radiant golden light rays. The camera follows gently behind her and slightly rises. Calm, serene, natural walking pace.

Photorealistic heavenly scene. The woman standing on the glowing white staircase smiles peacefully at the camera and gently waves goodbye with one hand, then slowly turns around and begins walking up the stairs toward Jesus, who waits at the top with open arms. Soft clouds drift, golden light rays. Her face and glasses remain identical, natural movement.

Photorealistic heavenly scene. The woman takes the last steps up the staircase and Jesus, in a white robe, welcomes her into a warm, tender embrace; she rests her head on his shoulder with a peaceful, happy smile and closes her eyes. Golden light grows softly brighter, clouds drift slowly. Gentle, emotional, slow motion feel.

Photorealistic close portrait. The woman smiles gently at the camera bathed in warm heavenly golden light, she blinks naturally and her smile grows a little, soft glowing clouds drift behind her. Very slow push-in. Her face, glasses and hair stay exactly the same.

Photorealistic heavenly scene. The woman and Jesus remain in a tender embrace at the top of the glowing staircase, swaying very slightly, peaceful smiles. The camera slowly pulls back and rises as warm golden light fills the frame and soft clouds drift. Serene, gentle, final farewell.
